eligibility.rule: Serves one of the Foundation's six counties
eligibility.quote: Applicant must provide programming or services within the six-county SCVF service area (Chisago and Washington counties in MN; Burnett, Polk, St. Croix, and Pierce counties in WI).
alt_quotes: Serve communities in one or more of the Foundation's six counties: Chisago, Washington (MN); Burnett, Polk, Pierce, St. Croix (WI)

eligibility.rule: 501(c)(3), government, tribal, educational or religious entity, or a fiscal sponsor
eligibility.quote: Applicant must be a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization; a governmental entity, tribal entity, educational or religious organization defined as tax exempt; or partner with an eligible fiscal agent.
alt_quotes: Be a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, government, tribal, educational, or religious entity Or partner with an eligible fiscal sponsor

eligibility.rule: No science, research or large-scale restoration
eligibility.quote: Requests to fund science, research, or large-scale restoration projects.
alt_quotes: Funding is not available for individuals, capital expenses, endowments, or large-scale restoration projects.

eligibility.quote: Please note, organizations are limited to one application to the Environmental Grant Program.

eligibility.rule: General operating support only for organisations with the environment at the core of their mission
eligibility.quote: Organizations with the Environment at the core of their mission and programs may apply for General Operating Support (grant range: $5,000-$25,000).

eligibility.rule: Funds spent within a year of the award
eligibility.quote: Grant funds must be expended within one year from the date of the award

effort.step: Apply online through the Foundation's application
effort.quote: To access the application visit: SCVF’s Website: Environmental Grant Page

notes: Spring cycle; the guidelines give April 22 to June 5 as the general timeline but the 2027 dates aren't published yet, so no due date. The application itself is an online form (not read); no document list is published.
